tasks.label: Compilar Tudo
tasks.command: mkdir -p Cliente/bin Servidor/bin && /usr/lib/jvm/zulu8-fx-bin/bin/javac -d Cliente/bin $(find Cliente -name '*.java') && cp Cliente/style.css Cliente/bin/ 2>/dev/null || true && mkdir -p Cliente/bin/view && cp Cliente/view/edenIcon.png Cliente/bin/view/ 2>/dev/null || true && /usr/lib/jvm/zulu8-fx-bin/bin/javac -d Servidor/bin $(find Servidor -name '*.java')
